market_definition: The U.S. 503B Compounding Pharmacies Market encompasses the commercial and institutional ecosystem of FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities that manufacture large batches of sterile and non-sterile compounded medications - often without a patient-specific prescription - to supply hospitals, clinics, surgery centers and healthcare systems for in-office administration and stock. By Molecule: Acetaminophen, Phenylephrine, Midazolam, Vancomycin, Epinephrine, Fentanyl, Bupivacaine, Morphine, Amiodarone, Heparin, Ketamine, Hydromorphone, Ketorolac, Ropivacaine, Clonidine, Mitomycin, Moxifloxacin, Fluconazole, Amphotericin, Gentamicin, Cyclosporine, Atropine Sulfate, Succinylcholine Chloride, Oxytocin, Famotidine, Hydralazine HCl, Glutathione, Hydroquinone, Salicylic Acid, Ascorbic Acid, Benzocaine, Tetracaine, Phenylephrine HCl, Spironolactone, Glutamine, Thiamine HCl, Niacinamide, Dexpanthenol, Pyridoxine HCl, Methionine, Cyanocobalamin, Aminophylline, Acyclovir, Azithromycin, Calcium Gluconate, Doxycycline, Hyaluronic Acid, Ibuprofen, Naltrexone, Ziconotide, Progesterone, Testosterone, Gabapentin, Sodium Chloride, Ondansetron, Sildenafil, Tadalafil, Minoxidil, Lorazepam, Propranolol Hydrochloride, Fluoxetine HCl, Finasteride, Baclofen, Cyclobenzaprine HCl, Cromolyn Sodium, Dexamethasone, Diltiazem HCl, Estradiol, Ketoprofen, Lidocaine, Levocetirizine, Phenol, Others (Dextrose and Others). By Therapeutic Area: Pain Management, Oncology Supportive Drugs, Ophthalmology, Cardiology, Orthopedics, Infectious Diseases, Gastroenterology, Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT), Neurology, Dermatology, Others (e.g. endocrinology, respiratory). EXCLUDED from the market: 503A patient-specific compounding (retail / community compounding requiring individual patient prescriptions); wholesaling and intermediaries (distribution via third-party wholesalers, brokers or repackagers - products must be sold directly to healthcare facilities); commercial copies (mass-producing identical copies of FDA-approved drugs unless the drug is on the FDA Drug Shortage List); unapproved bulk substances (bulk APIs not on the FDA 503B Bulks List); conventional manufacturing (FDA-approved mass pharma products under NDA / ANDA premarket approval). COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - 503B OUTSOURCING FACILITY: a company headquartered in the United States that operates an FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility and sells its compounded medications directly to hospitals, clinics, surgery centers and health systems (including 503B units of larger pharma or pharmacy groups). EXCLUDED companies: 503A-only compounding pharmacies; drug wholesalers, distributors, brokers and repackagers; conventional NDA / ANDA drug manufacturers without a 503B facility; bulk API suppliers; companies headquartered outside the United States.
who_is_included: SERVICE PROVIDER DEFINITION (services market): a company that PERFORMS this service commercially for third-party customers - it is contracted to do the work, or sells the course, inspection, survey or certification as its own offering. Operators, contractors, consultancies, accredited training organisations and certification bodies all qualify when this work is what customers pay them for. EXCLUDED: manufacturers whose only service is support or familiarisation for their own products; equipment sellers with no service delivery; marketplaces and directories that merely list providers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
